label: rem:bond-order-eq-jet-degree-sketch
title: Argument sketch: body order equals jet degree
html:
Step 1 — the cluster sub-braid sits at its jet degree. The canonical atomic braid word builds \mathcal{B}_K by concatenating one 3-strand block per nucleon and inserting the inter-nucleon crossings. Adding a nucleon to an (n-1)-cluster appends its block and the crossings binding it to the cluster, raising the Gröbner--Shirshov normal-form length by a fixed increment (Length-filtration spectral sequence of the Hochschild complex of H_n(R, q)). Reading this length through the jet-prefix order (Jet-level prefix formula via Gröbner–Shirshov filtration (candidate Term 6)) places the n-nucleon cluster sub-word at jet vertical degree n.

Step 2 — the graded component is the cluster term. The standard basis splits the length filtration, so the associated graded \mathrm{gr}_n is spanned by exactly the normal forms of filtration degree n, i.e. the n-nucleon cluster contributions. No contribution escapes a finite cluster degree (every sub-word has finite GS length), so the filtration is exhaustive.

Conclusion. Summing the graded components reconstructs the binding, and by Steps 1--2 the degree-n component equals the n-body term: \sum_n(\text{\(n\)-body term})=\sum_n\mathrm{gr}_n. In Body order equals jet degree the graded match (Steps 1--2) and exhaustiveness are the hypotheses, and the body-order = jet-graded sum identity follows from them. \qquad\blacksquare
